taker.definition: trigger candle taker buy quote volume / total quote volume; zero total is unavailable

funding.history: settled rates only, earlier than signal; constant verified cadence; interval changes/gaps unavailable

relative.endpoint: same venue, identical closed 4h endpoints and continuous windows

secondary_observations: post-entry raw MFE/MAE and 3/5/7/10/15 percent reach intervals
known_exploratory_window: 2026-08, never a holdout; old outputs retained
replay_parity: 119 closed bars, unchanged live core; earlier 120-bar research outputs cannot be pooled
causality: Never join future rows. Historical OI event timestamps do not prove publication time. Live retrospective enrichment retains receipt time and cannot be called available at signal.
comparison_design: Four separate one-filter arms; never stack them. Each compared with unchanged strategy, same-event random direction and random timing. Preserve all failed/unfilled/unresolved records. Report common-support and full-universe coverage separately.
outcome: existing structural stop and 2R target; 1m stop-first after entry, gap open used; ambiguous partial entry minute unresolved; 4/24/72h observations, 72h is censoring not forced exit

pass_requirements.insufficient_data: INCONCLUSIVE, not proof of failure or success
pass_requirements.primary_unit: equal-weight UTC entry-day mean net R; paired calendar day/block comparisons
pass_requirements.multiple_testing: 4 hypotheses x 2 directions x 3 comparators = 24 predeclared comparisons; family alpha 0.05, Bonferroni one-sided lower bound alpha 0.05/24 must exceed zero
pass_requirements.resampling: fixed-seed 20000 calendar-week block resamples, preserve empty/unknown days and report effective paired days; no trade-level iid inference
pass_requirements.missing_sensitivity: primary resolved results plus unresolved count and pessimistic loss sensitivity; cancellations remain cancellations

bybit_shadow.cohort: separate from Binance plans and outcomes
bybit_shadow.entry: native 100-level sampled book VWAP, exchange quantity minimum/step; additional 0.0002 residual slippage; no fill claim
bybit_shadow.exit: 1m path; stop slippage 0.001, target slippage 0.0002, plus entry half-spread proxy for future exit spread
bybit_shadow.funding: actual settled rate with native mark-minute-open proxy; unavailable/changed cadence unresolved
bybit_shadow.coverage: all new setups tracked, delivery state separate; old candidates never retroactively filled
bybit_shadow.missing_taker: Bybit candle API lacks taker flow; explicitly missing, never infer from candle colour or substitute Binance
bybit_shadow.limits: book displayed liquidity is not a real fill; unknown intraminute path and future depth remain modelling limits

freeze: No changes to live thresholds, weights, target, stop or filters during collection. Future hypotheses need a new version. No automatic profitability claim or promotion. Keep existing Binance absolute retry floor and venue separation.
deployment_research_policy: Completed August outputs retained. Do not automatically repeat August solely due to an observational code change. New historical hypothesis evaluation is separate from the production scan process.
